en: Sepia-toned historic view of a European city gate area. In the foreground there is a curved dirt road and a stone wall; behind it stands a large Baroque-style building with many dormer windows and an arched gate passage through its center. Trees flank the scene, and in the background a church tower with an onion-shaped dome is visible. Handwritten text in a decorative script appears along the bottom edge of the image.
